title: Intel Expects 14A performance to be within 5% of TSM's A14
author: Daniel Nenni
text:
Daniel Nenni
Founder
Staff member

Naga Chandrasekaran who is the EVP, CTO, and GM, Intel Foundry. In a meeting with Keybanc told them:Intel, "Expects 14A performance to be within 5% of TSM's A14".

Intel is not afraid of CoPoS. "Sees sustained leadership in advanced packaging with EMIB-T even with TSM introducing CoPoS".

I must say that the news around 14A PPA is truly extraordinary given 14A yields and ramp are extremely aggressive. Intel is finally sticking its neck out to say how their nodes compare with a % range to TSMC. Note goes on to say that Intel has a server part on 14A in 2028. Coral Rapids might not be on 18A-U if that's the case. Coral could be 14A, but I have capacity concerns (2029 is the big ramp, pointing towards 2029 Ohio volume)
